workflows.title: Get started
workflows.intro: Connect a computer, then turn on approvals on your phone. A click and one pasted line each, no sign-in: your AI watches this page and carries on as each step is done.

steps.title: Connect a computer
steps.text: Pick what it runs and press the button. You get one line to paste on that computer: it installs {product}, joins it to your account and starts it at boot.

steps.title: Turn on approvals on your phone
steps.text: Open this same link on your phone and turn notifications on there, so {product} can reach you when something needs you.

steps.title: Keep your account
steps.text: Optional: add a sign-in so you can come back to your account and its machines from anywhere.

steps.title: All set
steps.text: Go back to your AI: it can work on your computer now.

workflows.title: Connect a Linux server
workflows.intro: One line on your server installs {product}, joins it to your account and starts it at boot. Any Linux with systemd, on x86_64 or ARM64.

steps.title: Run one line on your server
steps.text: Press the button for your line. Paste it into a terminal on the server and press Enter; sudo may ask for your password.

steps.title: Connected
steps.text: Your server is online. Go back to your AI: it can work on it now.

workflows.title: Connect a Windows PC or laptop
workflows.intro: One line in PowerShell installs {product} for your Windows account (no administrator needed), joins the PC to your account and starts it when you sign in to Windows. x64 or ARM64.

steps.title: Run one line in PowerShell
steps.text: Press the button for your line. Open PowerShell on the PC (Start, type PowerShell, Enter), paste it and press Enter.

steps.title: Connected
steps.text: Your PC is online. Go back to your AI: it can work on it now.

workflows.title: Connect a Mac
workflows.intro: A Mac would join the same way as a Linux server or a Windows PC.
workflows.unavailable: A Mac build of {product} is not available yet, so there is nothing to install on a Mac. Linux and Windows machines connect today.

workflows.title: Turn on approvals on your phone
workflows.intro: Turn notifications on for {product} on your phone, so it can reach you when something needs you, like a step your AI wants you to approve.

steps.title: Turn on notifications on your phone
steps.text: Open this link on your phone and press the button. On an iPhone, first add this page to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
